scope: New diagnostic analysis only; the original identification, preregistered Vehicle B protocol, and scoped-negative-result artifact remain unchanged.
source_bound_rule: coefficient = baseline + q * max(abs(baseline), 0.05), with q constrained to [-2, 2]

source_audit.discrepancy_disposition: No third coefficient is designated: the immutable source artifact has only two final values at a bound. N_rrr, the closest remaining normalized magnitude, is q=1.227368934 and is not a bound hit.

relaxed_bounds.rationale: Widen each reproducible active bound by 5x in normalized half-width. This is a fixed substantial relaxation, selected before rerunning, while retaining finite protection against numerical runaway and holding the data, residuals, ridge regularization, initialization, and iteration budget fixed.

predictions.tightly_bounded_prediction: If the original constraints were merely too tight, at least one formerly pinned coefficient should converge away from the relaxed bounds and held-out zig-zag error should improve substantially.
predictions.underdetermined_prediction: If turning-circle data do not constrain these terms, a formerly pinned coefficient will run to a relaxed bound or the fit will remain unstable/non-improving.
predictions.substantial_improvement_rule: At least 20% reduction from the original fit in both the median held-out zig-zag heading RMSE and median held-out zig-zag yaw-rate RMSE; report every trajectory and IMO metric regardless.
predictions.stable_away_from_new_bound_rule: abs(q) <= 9.5 for a relaxed coefficient (at least 5% of the relaxed half-width away from either boundary).

bound_provenance.numeric_bounds: Repository identification implementation choice in identify.mjs: +/-2 normalized scales around the literature baseline; no external literature source is cited for the numeric optimization bounds.
bound_provenance.coefficient_baselines: Yasukawa & Yoshimura (2015), Table 3, KVLCC2 captive-test/model coefficient parameterization, as recorded in validation/external-references/kvlcc2/kvlcc2-l7.json.
bound_provenance.scale_caveat: The baselines concern KVLCC2 model-structure analysis and are not Vehicle-B-USV coefficients.
